result.summary: Several visual and data issues: delivery cost shows as €NaN (broken data), restaurant names are truncated, and category chips overflow the screen edge.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows delivery cost as '€NaN delivery', indicating a null/undefined price was rendered instead of a valid amount.
issues.suggestion: Validate and format delivery fees before display; fall back to a sensible default or hide the fee when the value is missing.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word in the Fastest near you row, so the full name is not readable.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on tap so names are not truncated awkwardly.

issues.description: Category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) overflow the right edge of the screen with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Make the chip row horizontally scrollable with padding/fade, or wrap chips so all options stay fully visible.

issues.description: Bottom navigation labels and icons appear uneven in weight/color (Home is strongly emphasized while others look washed out).
issues.suggestion: Ensure inactive tab styles still meet contrast guidelines and keep consistent icon/label alignment and weight.
